title: Grids overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Use alignment to make information easier to find while giving collaborators a common compositional structure.
strategic_value: A shared but flexible framework can connect Verizon layouts across projects and channels.
demonstration: The September 17, 2019 overview places cyan grid overlays on three compositions, then separates web, email, print and online-advertising grid references.
practical_value: Start from the applicable channel’s grid rather than applying one fixed grid to every format.

content_islands.name: Composition examples
content_islands.spec: Pair one tall image-led layout at left with two wide type-and-product layouts at right, retaining all cyan guides.

content_islands.name: Channel references
content_islands.spec: Align four smaller references for web, email, print and OLA below the channel-specific explanation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text ties grids to navigation, collaboration and consistency.
reference_purposes.Application: Cyan overlays show alignment across three distinct layouts.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source says grids are not one-size-fits-all and directs readers to channel-specific rules.

ingredient.name: Channel grid
